summary: Two aircraft collided mid-air over Boulder County around 8:54 a.m.; wreckage at the 10,000 block of Niwot Road (2 occupants, both deceased) and the 9,700 block (1 occupant, deceased); BCSO Search and Rescue, coroner, fire, CSP, FAA/NTSB responded.
notes: BCSO case #22-04695. Aviation crash included per the id 2760 (2022-07-17 Cessna crash) and id 1745 (2012-08-31 plane crash) precedents — BCSO SAR responded. Inserted run 1014 (BCSO chunk).
